first_error_evidence: Agent aborted the wget download at ~22% completion (exit code 130 via C-c), prematurely terminating the kernel source acquisition.
verification_evidence: Step 30 QEMU boot output clearly shows '[    0.000000] Hello, this is a custom kernel' in the kernel log, confirming the custom printk was compiled into the kernel and executed at boot.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent explored the environment, downloaded and extracted Linux 6.9 source (with a download interruption requiring resume), added a custom printk to start_kernel, built the kernel, generated an initramfs (recovering from a wrong-directory error), and verified the custom message appeared in QEMU boot output, though it spent the final 10 steps ineffectively attempting to exit the QEMU session.
